title: Rundle
summary: RUND'LE, noun [from round.] 1. A round; a step of a ladder. 2. Something put round an axis; a peritrochium; as a cylinder with a rundle about it.

inlines.v: RUND'LE, noun [from round.] 1. A round; a step of a ladder. 2. Something put round an axis; a peritrochium; as a cylinder with a rundle about it.
